description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and Accuracy, with three distinct lines representing different trends. The x-axis, labeled Initial Confidence, has a linear scale, ranging from 0.91 to 0.98, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled Accuracy, also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue solid line starts at approximately 0.78 on the y-axis at an Initial Confidence of 0.91, increases to around 0.98 at 0.92, and remains relatively stable, ending at about 0.98 at an Initial Confidence of 0.98. The orange dashed line begins at around 0.65 at 0.91, peaks at approximately 0.88 at 0.92, and then declines steadily to about 0.12 at 0.98. The green dash-dotted line starts at around 0.2 at 0.91, decreases slightly to approximately 0.1 at 0.92, and then increases steadily to about 0.88 at 0.98. Each line is accompanied by error bars indicating the range of variation in the data.
